page.overview:
Who is Bearded Merc?

The Bearded Merc was one of Eli Mills' mercenaries. He was part of Ken Wheatley's team on Isla Nublar, present during the capture of Blue after she'd killed one of his fellow mercenaries. He later served as security at the front entrance of Lockwood Manor. He was the one who noticed Owen Grady and Claire Dearing driving the Mercedes-Benz Unimog in the column of approaching trucks. Recognizing them from the island, he alerted Wheatley.
